title: Premium Arrears Settlements Taken from a ShieldCare Customer
content:
## The request this covers

A customer may ask to bring the premium on a Northbeam ShieldCare Protection Plan back into order. The
amount the customer settles is fixed only after every fee owed for a period that has run past grace
stands billed on the plan. What is then taken from the customer is recorded as a premium payment against
the plan, and the premium still owed on the plan falls by the amount paid.

## Recording the payment

The payment is recorded with `settle_premium_arrears_c5640f60`. This is the customer's own tool: it is
unlocked and handed over, and the customer themselves runs it, since paying money on their own plan is
their act and not the agent's. One call records a single premium payment against the named plan, applied
from the oldest unpaid premium period given, and lowers the premium still owed on that plan by the amount
paid, so the plan shows what is left owing straight away. The customer sees the payment on the plan's
premium history and the reduced balance on the plan.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `plan_id` | An identifier: the reference number of the ShieldCare protection plan the payment is made against, as read out to the customer from the plan record. |
| `settlement_amount` | A fixed-format money amount: the amount the customer is paying, in USD to 2 decimal places, rounded half to even at the cent when a longer figure is passed. There is no empty value. |
| `period_start` | A fixed-format date: the first day of the oldest premium period the payment is applied from, written as YYYY-MM-DD in the retailer's own local calendar with no time part. There is no empty value. |
| `payment_method` | An enumerated value: how the customer is paying, one of `card_on_file`, the payment card already held on the profile; `store_credit`, the balance of store credit on the profile; `bank_transfer`, money sent from the customer's bank account; `in_store_cash`, cash or card handed over at a branch counter; `business_invoice`, the amount put on the invoice account a business profile settles on terms. |

## What comes back

A single confirmation sentence in plain text, naming the reference of the new payment entry, a string
beginning ppy_, the plan it was applied to, the amount paid in USD to two decimal places, and the premium
still outstanding on the plan in USD to two decimal places. A sentence beginning "Premium payment
received" means the money was taken and the plan's outstanding premium was reduced.
